design.description: Slide the shuttle across Kanjivaram silk, unfold three celebration sarees and exchange garlands.

html:
Dear Your Family,

An invitation woven in silk

Pranav & Harini

30 · 05 · 2027 · Chennai

Drag the shuttle across

Best with sound on

Dear Your Family,

You are invited to the wedding of

Pranav&Harini

Sunday · 30 May 2027 · Chennai

Scroll to weave

A wedding woven in Kanjivaram silk

Woven together

Pranav & Harini

ARE GETTING MARRIED

SCROLL

Shri Ganeshaya Namah

With the blessings of our elders

Mr. K. Ramesh & Mrs. R. Lalitha

request the pleasure of your company at the wedding of their son

Pranav

with

Harini

daughter of Mr. V. Sundar & Mrs. S. Padma

Saturday 29 & Sunday 30 May 2027
Chennai

Three sarees, three celebrations

Pick a saree

Tap a saree and it opens across the counter, just like at the silk shop.

Tap a saree above

A playful ritual

Maalai Maatral

The garlands are exchanged three times. Tap to swap them!

Good to know

Things to know

What to wear

Pinks for the Nichayathartham, jewel tones for the Reception, traditional silks for the Muhurtham.

The feast

Lunch on banana leaf after the Nichayathartham and the Muhurtham, dinner at the Reception.

Parking

Valet at the Reception. Street parking near the mandapam in Mylapore.

Gifts

Your presence and your blessings are all we wish for.

RSVP

Will you join us?

Kindly reply by 15 May 2027.

Will you attend?
You'll join us for

2

Please add your name so the family knows who replied.

Your reply goes directly to the hosts through WhatsApp.

Every thread, a blessing

Woven together, forever

Counting down to the muhurtham

With love

The Ramesh & Sundar families
